root_cause: The pricing build-integrity restore preserved only section#pakketten, while lifecycle, plan-group and billing interaction controls live in the preceding section#prijzen-pakketten. V18 transforms could therefore alter or remove interaction attributes before production even though the canonical source still contained them.
prevention: Treat the interactive pricing intro and package section as one atomic build-preservation contract.
Restore both section#prijzen-pakketten and section#pakketten from the captured canonical source after V18 transforms.
Fail the build if lifecycle, stage-panel, plan-tab or billing selectors are missing after restore.
Production closure requires the existing browser verifier to click lifecycle, plan and billing controls and then switch to the static English route.
Section extraction must match id attributes independent of HTML attribute order.
Use the protected Production Source Snapshot workflow as the canonical terminal deploy path; never bypass the required test gate.
Do not transition this learning to LIVE_BEWEZEN until exact production SHA/context/deploy-id and the pricing/i18n Playwright interaction gate are both green.

evidence.failure: Playwright timed out waiting for [data-bg-stage="loss"] although exact source contained the selector.

secondary_root_cause: The first preservation implementation assumed the id attribute immediately followed <section. The real pricing intro markup has class before id, so extractSection could not find section#prijzen-pakketten and Netlify exited during the build.
